entry.name: keyboardLayoutAlways
entry.label: Show the keyboard layout badge also when only one layout is configured

entry.name: showKdeConnect
entry.label: Show a phone button while a KDE Connect device is connected

entry.name: showBatteryPercent
entry.label: Show the battery percentage in the status pill

entry.name: popupOnNewDevice
entry.label: Open Disks & Devices when a removable device is connected

entry.name: showNotifications
entry.label: Show the notification bell and the notification list

entry.name: popupGap
entry.label: Gap between the top bar and the pop-up, in pixels

entry.name: popupScreenMargin
entry.label: Distance between the pop-up and the right screen edge, in pixels

entry.name: startPage
entry.label: Page shown when the pop-up opens: main, wifi, bluetooth or audio

entry.name: keyboardPolicy
entry.label: On-screen keyboard (kwinrc [Wayland] InputMethod, TABLET 4.6): "tablet" (in tablet posture only; the process stops on the laptop), "touch" (always; KWin shows it on a touch or pen tap) or "never"

entry.name: openRequest
entry.label: Written by other shell parts through desktop scripting: "MODE:NONCE" or "MODE:NONCE:OUTPUT" with MODE sheet (quick settings), notifications (the list, as the bell), toggle or close. Without OUTPUT only the widget on KWin's active screen acts. "MODE NONCE" is accepted too.

entry.name: tabletNotifications
entry.label: Tablet posture: "apart" (the bell, the clock's pull-down and Meta+N open the Notification Centre, the status pill only the controls) or "together" (one sheet with controls and notifications, as on the laptop). TABLET2 S1.

entry.name: airplaneRestore
entry.label: The radios that were on when airplane mode started, as JSON ({wifi, wwan, bluetooth}); empty when airplane mode is off. Kept so that a plasmashell restart does not lose it.

entry.name: debugAction
entry.label: Testing only: run one action and clear the key. Values: dump:TAG (logs the sheet's geometry and scrolling, every visible target of the bar and the sheet with its centre and size, and the tablet policy state).

entry.name: lightLookAndFeel
entry.label: Global Theme used when Dark style is switched off

entry.name: darkLookAndFeel
entry.label: Global Theme used when Dark style is switched on
